final.memo:
Our original governance campaign for the Company has been a success, resulting in board representation and the appointment of a new CEO [D03, D07]. With the primary governance catalyst realized, we are transitioning from an activist posture to an investor assessing the merits of the core business turnaround and the optionality of our Asian affiliates [D01, D08]. 

While the company has accelerated product development across its core suite, revenue and adjusted operating measures have yet to show a meaningful inflection [D03, D07]. The current economic reality of the core advertising business remains challenged, with second-quarter GAAP revenue down 7% and non-GAAP operating income falling 13% [D03]. 

We have the opportunity to utilize issuer block-liquidity terms to harvest a portion of our gain [D02, D04]. This allows us to manage risk and lock in profits crystallized by our successful governance intervention while maintaining residual exposure to the long-term potential of the Asian assets [D02, D04]. We remain cognizant that holding the remaining equity now relies on the product turnaround compounding, rather than just board-level changes [D04, D05].
